framework.primary_law: No federal AI law. PDPL (Decree-Law 45/2021), National AI Strategy 2031, DIFC Regulation 10 (AI, January 2026)
framework.enforcing_body: UAE Data Office; DIFC Commissioner; sector regulators (CBUAE, DFSA, FSRA, DHA)
framework.max_penalty: PDPL fines up to AED 5 million; DIFC Regulation 10: US$25,000 to 50,000 per violation
framework.geographic_scope: Federal data law nationwide; DIFC rules apply to DIFC-registered entities.

research.summary: The UAE has no single AI law; a federal framework has been discussed but not enacted. Governance is layered: the federal PDPL (full compliance due 1 January 2027), non-binding strategy and ethics guidance, a 2024 Child Digital Safety Law, and DIFC Regulation 10 (in force January 2026), which requires AI impact assessments and transparency for high-risk uses by DIFC entities.

key_provisions.title: PDPL
key_provisions.description: Consent-based processing and human oversight for automated decisions affecting individuals.

key_provisions.title: DIFC Regulation 10
key_provisions.description: AI impact assessments, transparency and documentation for high-risk uses.

key_provisions.title: National AI Strategy 2031
key_provisions.description: Non-binding strategy and ethics guide referenced in procurement.

cross_jurisdiction_tensions.tension: The UAE courts both US and Chinese AI partnerships while building its own rules.

privacy_data_protection.rationale: PDPL applies with consent as the main basis.

human_oversight.rationale: Human oversight for automated decisions under PDPL.

gaps_and_weaknesses: Fragmented rules across federal, free-zone and sector regimes.
research.monitor_notes: The source is a law-firm guide; check primary texts. Dubai-level AI rules and the 2024 AI charter were not verified. Scores are provisional AI-drafted judgements against the AIETHOS rubric and reflect protections currently in force.

citizen.one_line: The UAE has no single AI law; rules differ between the federal government, free zones and sectors.
citizen.what_changed: Since January 2026, firms in the Dubai International Financial Centre must assess the impact of high-risk AI.
citizen.who_is_protected: People in the UAE through PDPL; stronger inside DIFC.
who_is_not_protected: People outside DIFC where only general rules apply

your_rights.what_it_means: PDPL requires human oversight for automated decisions affecting individuals.
your_rights.how_to_invoke: Ask the company; complain to the UAE Data Office.

citizen.plain_language_summary: The UAE's AI rules are a patchwork. Check whether the company is in a free zone like DIFC.

jargon_buster.Free zone: A special area with its own business laws, such as DIFC or ADGM.
jargon_buster.PDPL: The UAE federal personal data protection law.
